# vyos.blueprints.zone_firewall

Zone-based firewall (docs blueprint "Zone-Policy example")

- Defines zones, one ruleset per zone-pair-direction named `<from>-<to>` for IPv4 and `<from>-<to>-6` for IPv6, and binds the rulesets to the zones, following the practices on the docs page.
- Every ruleset gets `default-action drop`, `default-log` and the two base rules from the page (1 accept established/related, 2 drop and log invalid). Rules 1 and 2 are therefore reserved.
- With `zone_firewall_all_pairs`, rulesets are created for every zone pair, including pairs that never communicate, so attempts are logged.
- Uses vyos.vyos.vyos_firewall_rules and vyos.vyos.vyos_firewall_global (zone support requires a vyos.vyos release that includes it).
- Lockout risk as the page warns - put the interface you manage the router through into a zone with rules allowing SSH to the local zone before running this role.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.zone_firewall
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `zone_firewall_zones` | list | yes |  | Zones. Exactly one may be the local zone (the router itself). |
| `zone_firewall_zones.name` | str | yes |  | Zone name, e.g. `lan`. |
| `zone_firewall_zones.interfaces` | list |  | `[]` | Member interfaces, e.g. `[eth0.20]`. Not used for the local zone. |
| `zone_firewall_zones.local` | bool |  | `false` | This zone is the router itself. |
| `zone_firewall_zones.default_action` | str |  | `drop` | Zone default action (zones cannot accept). |
| `zone_firewall_zones.default_log` | bool |  | `true` | Log packets hitting the zone default action. |
| `zone_firewall_zones.description` | str |  |  | Zone description. |
| `zone_firewall_policies` | list |  | `[]` | Rules per zone-pair-direction (traffic from `from` to `to`). |
| `zone_firewall_policies.from` | str | yes |  | Source zone. |
| `zone_firewall_policies.to` | str | yes |  | Destination zone. |
| `zone_firewall_policies.default_action` | str |  | `drop` | Ruleset default action, e.g. `accept` for a management zone. |
| `zone_firewall_policies.rules` | list |  | `[]` | Rules added after the base rules. |
| `zone_firewall_policies.rules.number` | int | yes |  | Rule number (not 1 or 2 while base rules are on). |
| `zone_firewall_policies.rules.action` | str |  | `accept` | Rule action. |
| `zone_firewall_policies.rules.description` | str |  |  | Rule description. |
| `zone_firewall_policies.rules.protocol` | str |  |  | Protocol, e.g. `tcp`, `udp`, `tcp_udp`, `icmp`. `icmp` becomes `ipv6-icmp` in the IPv6 ruleset. |
| `zone_firewall_policies.rules.source` | dict |  |  | Source match. |
| `zone_firewall_policies.rules.source.address` | str |  |  | Address or network. |
| `zone_firewall_policies.rules.source.port` | str |  |  | Port(s), e.g. `22` or `20,21`. |
| `zone_firewall_policies.rules.destination` | dict |  |  | Destination match. |
| `zone_firewall_policies.rules.destination.address` | str |  |  | Address or network. |
| `zone_firewall_policies.rules.destination.port` | str |  |  | Port(s), e.g. `80,443`. |
| `zone_firewall_policies.rules.family` | str |  |  | Rulesets the rule goes into. Inferred when omitted - an IPv6 address means `ipv6`, an IPv4 address `ipv4`, no address `both`. |
| `zone_firewall_policies.rules.log` | bool |  |  | Log matches. Defaults to `zone_firewall_log_rules`. |
| `zone_firewall_ipv6` | bool |  | `true` | Also create IPv6 rulesets and bind them. |
| `zone_firewall_all_pairs` | bool |  | `true` | Create a (base rules only) ruleset for every zone pair not listed. |
| `zone_firewall_base_rules` | bool |  | `true` | Add the page's rules 1 (established/related) and 2 (invalid) to every ruleset. |
| `zone_firewall_log_rules` | bool |  | `true` | Default for `log` on user rules, as the page recommends. |
| `vyos_blueprints_render_only` | bool |  | `false` | Collect commands into `vyos_blueprints_rendered` instead of configuring. |

## Entry point `verify` (`tasks_from: verify`)

Run with `tasks_from=verify`. Checks every zone and its member interfaces are active.

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `zone_firewall_zones` | list | yes |  | Same value as for `main`. |
